lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs arranged in organized vertical columns across the lateral flank, exhibiting roughly equidistant spacing between adjacent spots within the same column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with and encapsulate the circular blobs, creating a defined grid-like anchor node system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal ridges visible across the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed regions below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a pectoral fin in the lower right corner displaying a high-density distribution of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots distinct from the flank pattern.
